title: 'It was the chance of our lives': After short exile in Ceuta, tens of thousands of young people return to Morocco

title: Wildfire in southwest France: Local officials recount 10 days of battling the blaze
subhead: The prefect of the affected Gironde region, Sophie Brocas, and the head of its fire and rescue service, Marc Vermeulen, reflect on their management of the massive wildfire that has been raging since July 22 in an interview with Le Monde.

title: The Tour d'Argent: Three generations at the pinnacle of Parisian dining
subhead: 'More Than A Restaurant' (5/6). Perched above the Seine and facing Notre-Dame, this legendary establishment earned its renown with its pressed duck recipe served since the 19th century. It's been run by the Terrail family for three generations.

title: French-American jazz duo DOMi & JD Beck release genre-defying second album

title: Kush, a synthetic and highly addictive drug, devastates Sierra Leone and Liberia
subhead: 'Africa under the influence' (2/6). Sold at a low price, kush causes rapid addiction and severe, often fatal, injuries. Photographer Gaël Turine traveled to Freetown and Monrovia to document the destruction wrought by this new synthetic drug among young people in Sierra Leone and Liberia.
